compiled_state.title: As a reviewer finding, I include a mandatory cited_lines evidence field that flows through the entire review pipeline
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Add a cited_lines mandatory field to reviewer-base.md schema (min 1 entry per finding). Modify write-reviewer-findings.sh to validate cited_lines is non-empty with a specified format. Update the security overlay delta to replace "Do NOT add extra fields" with an enumerated allowlist including cited_lines. Update resolve-overlay-findings.sh to pass cited_lines through during overlay merge. Update the deep-arch delta to preserve cited_lines from specialist findings during synthesis. Rebuild all 10 agent files. Activate the write-reviewer-findings.sh validation gate ONLY AFTER all agents are rebuilt and smoke-tested.

**Why**: Mandatory evidence citations force reviewers to anchor claims to visible code, eliminating the "cites code not in the diff" class of invalid findings.

**Scope**:
- IN: reviewer-base.md schema section (cited_lines field with format spec); write-reviewer-findings.sh format validation with regex; security overlay delta allowlist replacement; resolve-overlay-findings.sh pass-through; deep-arch delta preservation; rebuild all 10 agents; smoke-test verification before gate activation
- OUT: Performance/accessibility overlay delta updates — security overlay is the highest-risk delta; others to be audited in doc story if needed

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, reviewer-base.md schema section requires a cited_lines field (minimum 1 entry) per finding; accepted formats are `<path>:<line>` or `~<path>:<line>` where "~" denotes approximate CI citations; "~" alone, empty strings, and entries without a colon-delimited positive integer line number are rejected
  ← Satisfies: "reviewer-base.md requires a cited_lines field (minimum 1 entry) per finding in the schema section. Lines prefixed with '~' denote approximate citations"
- When this story is complete, write-reviewer-findings.sh validates cited_lines is non-empty and that every entry matches the accepted format regex; findings with missing or invalid cited_lines are rejected
  ← Satisfies: "write-reviewer-findings.sh validates the field is non-empty"
- When this story is complete, unit tests cover: accepted forms (src/foo.sh:42, ~src/foo.sh:42), rejected forms (~alone, empty string, unknown, src/foo.sh without line number)
  ← Satisfies: cited_lines format validation is precise (RT-6)
- When this story is complete, the security overlay delta's "Do NOT add extra fields" prohibition is replaced with an enumerated allowlist that includes cited_lines
  ← Satisfies: "The security overlay delta's 'Do NOT add extra fields' prohibition is replaced with an enumerated allowlist that includes cited_lines"
- When this story is complete, resolve-overlay-findings.sh passes cited_lines through during overlay merge without stripping or modifying its value
  ← Satisfies: "resolve-overlay-findings.sh passes cited_lines through during overlay merge"
- When this story is complete, the deep-arch delta preserves cited_lines from specialist findings during synthesis
  ← Satisfies: "The deep-arch delta preserves cited_lines from specialist findings during synthesis"
- When this story is complete, write-reviewer-findings.sh validation is activated ONLY AFTER all 10 agents have been rebuilt with the new schema instruction and verified via a smoke-test review that confirms cited_lines appears in generated findings
  ← Satisfies: cited_lines gate does not break in-flight reviews (RT-2: pipeline-break window)
- When this story is complete, all 10 generated reviewer agent files are rebuilt via build-review-agents.sh and each file contains all 4 rubric sections: severity calibration, NOT-flag rules, diff-boundary discipline, and cited_lines schema
  ← Satisfies: SC1+SC2+SC3+SC4 cumulative verification (RT-1: final authoritative rebuild+verify pass)
- When this story is complete, unit tests are written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Reliability] RT-2: cited_lines validation gate activation must be sequenced as a final task within this story's implementation plan — after rebuild confirmed, not before
- [Testing] RT-1: S1–S3 committed reviewer-base.md section edits only; this story's Done Definition 8 is the authoritative cumulative verification that all 4 sections are present in all 10 files
- [Testing] New code paths in resolve-overlay-findings.sh overlay merge and deep-arch delta cited_lines preservation have no existing test coverage — tests required

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
